body_html: We were JAMMIN at BLAKE ST. TAVERN last night!! It was CRAZY!!! The DANCEFLOOR was PACKED ALL NIGHT LONG! I personally feel like this was ONE OF THE BEST SHOWS OF MY LIFE!! On top of the NON-STOP beats that kept PUMPIN thru the speakers, we had a COSTUME CONTEST! There were some AMAZING COSTUMES and I wish we could have given PRIZES to everyone, but it came down to just one! “Dwight Goodman” of “Dodgeball” took our FIRST PLACE PRIZE ($100 GIFT CERTIFICATE to BLAKE ST. TAVERN)! You should have seen him, the full outfit of Global Gym, a dodgeball in hand, and he looked identical to Ben Stiller!!! The night was a SCREAM!!!!!
